info.title: Fusion HCM (live reads)
info.description:
Reached through VB's server-side proxy, so the browser never sees the pod url or any credential (NFR-005). Deliberately small: master data still arrives through the OC_TIME_* cache, which is what OC_TIME_PKG can enforce rules over. Add operations here only for something the cache genuinely cannot answer, and write anything a rule must later validate back through ORDS — a value fetched straight into the page passes no rule at all.

Every query below was verified live against the dev20 pod on 08-Aug-2026.
x-traps: The filter separator is ' AND ', never ';'. A semicolon returns 400 on this pod.
Filter absence on OVERLAP, not containment: endDate>=from AND startDate<=to. Using startDate>=from silently drops a leave that began before the window and runs into it.

/absences takes personId, the internal numeric id — NOT PersonNumber. Passing the person number returns 200 with zero items, which reads exactly like 'this person has no leave'. Resolve it with getWorkers first.
Fusion returns approvalStatusCd 'APPROVED' in caps; populate_month filters on exactly 'Approved'. The wrong case caches fine and then never becomes a timesheet row.
duration is in DAYS ('1 Days' on the Fusion screen). The timesheet stores HOURS.

servers.description: Resolved by VB from services/catalog.json. Credentials are held in the VB Studio backend configuration, never in source.

get.summary: Worker lookup, and the connection probe. Called with no q it asks for a single worker and nothing else — the cheapest call that still proves auth, routing and payload shape. Called with q it resolves PersonNumber to the PersonId that /absences requires.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Fusion filter. To resolve a worker: PersonNumber='RI2824'. Omit entirely for the reachability probe.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Kept at 1. This is a lookup, not a data pull — pulling all 5976 workers here would be slow and pointless.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: Drops Fusion's HATEOAS links block, which is far larger than the record itself.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: PersonNumber is what OC_TIME_WORKER.EMPLOYEE_ID holds, so seeing one confirms the two systems agree on the key. PersonId is what every other HCM call is keyed on (INT-001).

401.description: The proxy reached Fusion but the credentials were refused

403.description: Authenticated, but the service account lacks the HCM data role

404.description: Wrong resource path or REST version for this pod

get.summary: Approved and scheduled absences for one person over a date window. This is the one input read live per person per date rather than prepopulated, because leave is system-owned by Absence Management (RULE-008) and can be applied, changed or cancelled after a timesheet has already been built.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: personId={id} AND endDate>='{from}' AND startDate<='{to}'. Note ' AND ', not ';', and the overlap form — see x-traps.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: A week has at most seven days of leave; 100 is headroom for a long absence returned as many rows.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: absenceType is the display name that becomes OC_TS_ENTRY.ABSENCE_TYPE. Both status codes are read because they mean different things: absenceStatusCd was SUBMITTED for a leave the Fusion screen showed as Completed, so the screen's Scheduled/Completed label is derived from the dates, not from this code.

200.description: Absences overlapping the window; an empty items array means none

400.description: Almost always the filter syntax — a ';' separator instead of ' AND '

401.description: The proxy reached Fusion but the credentials were refused

403.description: Authenticated, but the account lacks the Absence data role
